scene: opening a café door, sunglasses held in the hand

intro.ko: 긴 울 코트에 오트밀 니트와 회색 플란넬 팬츠를 입었다. 목도리를 감고, 실내로 들어서기 전 선글라스를 손에 들었다.
intro.en: A long wool coat goes over an oatmeal knit and grey flannel trousers. Wrap the scarf close and slip the sunglasses off as you head inside.
intro.de: Zum langen Wollmantel kommen ein haferfarbener Strickpullover und eine graue Flanellhose. Den Schal eng wickeln und die Sonnenbrille vor dem Hereingehen absetzen.

deck.ko: 카페 문을 밀며 선글라스를 벗는, 맑고 쌀쌀한 한낮의 긴 코트 차림.
deck.en: A long coat for a bright, chilly noon, sunglasses off as the café door swings open.
deck.de: Ein langer Mantel für einen hellen, kühlen Mittag – die Sonnenbrille kommt an der Café-Tür ab.

tip.ko: 실내외를 자주 오가는 날엔 목도리와 비니를 벗기 쉬운 것으로 골라, 코트만 입은 차림도 완성돼 보이게 해요.
tip.en: On a day of popping in and out, choose a scarf and beanie that come off easily so the coat alone still looks finished.
tip.de: An Tagen mit viel Rein und Raus Schal und Mütze wählen, die sich leicht abnehmen lassen – der Mantel allein soll trotzdem fertig wirken.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

products.spec: charcoal wool overcoat, long below knee

howToWear.ko: 아래쪽 단추만 잠가 오트밀 니트를 살짝 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Fasten a lower button to leave the oatmeal knit visible.
howToWear.de: Nur einen unteren Knopf schließen, damit der haferfarbene Strick sichtbar bleibt.

howToWear.ko: 리브 니트의 밝은 색을 차콜 코트 안쪽에서 살린다.
howToWear.en: Let the light rib knit brighten the opening of the charcoal coat.
howToWear.de: Der helle Rippstrick setzt einen Akzent im offenen Mantel.

howToWear.ko: 통 넓은 플란넬은 부츠 위에 자연스럽게 떨어지도록 입는다.
howToWear.en: Let the wide flannel legs fall naturally over the boots.
howToWear.de: Die weiten Flanellbeine locker über die Stiefel fallen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 와이드 팬츠 밑에서 더비 부츠의 둥근 앞코를 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Let the derby boots’ rounded toes show below the wide trousers.
howToWear.de: Die runden Kappen der Derby-Stiefel unter der weiten Hose sichtbar lassen.

howToWear.ko: 비니를 낮게 써서 카페 앞에서 기다릴 때 귀를 덮는다.
howToWear.en: Pull the beanie low enough to cover the ears while waiting outside.
howToWear.de: Beim Warten draußen die Mütze über die Ohren ziehen.

howToWear.ko: 목에 한 번 감아 코트 깃 위로 끝을 늘어뜨린다.
howToWear.en: Wrap it once and let the ends fall over the coat lapels.
howToWear.de: Einmal um den Hals wickeln und die Enden über dem Revers hängen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 실내에 들어가기 전에 벗어 다리 한쪽을 가볍게 쥔다.
howToWear.en: Remove the sunglasses at the door and hold them by one temple.
howToWear.de: An der Tür absetzen und locker an einem Bügel halten.

howToWear.ko: 부츠에 신되 걸을 때 바짓단이 양말을 덮게 한다.
howToWear.en: Wear them with the boots and let the trouser hems fall over them.
howToWear.de: Im Stiefel tragen und die Hosenbeine darüber fallen lassen.
